quote: p28 Note 11 Technical Provisions, 2020 columns Gross | RI | Net (£000): Balance at 1 January 27,015 | (5,552) | 21,463; Change in prior year provisions 934 | 957 | 1,891; Expected cost of current year claims 9,031 | (1,212) | 7,819; Claims paid during the year (10,915) | 2,334 | (8,582); Effect of exchange rates 355 | (582) | (226); Balance as at 31 December 26,420 | (4,055) | 22,365. p13 Claims paid Gross amount (10,916); Change in the provision for claims Gross amount 950.
arithmetic: Gross column roll-forward: 27,015 + 934 + 9,031 - 10,915 + 355 = 26,420, which ties to the printed closing balance, so +934 adds to the provision (strengthening). P&L p13: gross claims incurred = 10,916 paid - 950 fall in gross provision = 9,966 = 934 + 9,031 (+1 rounding). So 934 is the prior-year part of gross incurred, with claims paid accounted for; it is not a bare provision change. 934 GBP000 = +0.934m. Tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 0.934 = 0.047) = 0.5; |0.934 - 0.934| = 0.000, within.
basis_check: Note 11 prints Gross, RI and Net columns; 934 is the Gross column (net is 1,891). Gross, as the record claims.
page_binding_check: Single-syndicate report; pages 13, 26 and 28 are headed 'SYNDICATE 6125'. The business is accepted from Syndicate 4000 (p26), but Note 11 is 6125's own technical provisions note, and its closing gross 26,420 ties to the total of the p26 gross triangle. This syndicate's figure.
triangle_arithmetic: Reference only: the route is a model reading of Note 11, and the notes record CODE PYD NOT APPLIED, not an override. p26 'Gross claims development', pure underwriting year, GBP000, UW years <= 2020 - 2 = 2018: 2016: 10,749 - 10,633 = +116; 2017: 13,860 - 14,397 = -537; 2018: 19,640 - 19,681 = -41; sum -462 = -0.462m. The printed latest diagonal less 'cumulative payments to date' gives the printed provisions: 10,749 - 9,105 = 1,644; 13,860 - 11,669 = 2,191; 19,640 - 13,949 = 5,691; 14,687 - 5,209 = 9,478; 8,579 - 1,163 = 7,416; total 26,420. The stored grid matches the printed table.
reasoning: The filing states the gross prior-year movement explicitly (Note 11, 'Change in prior year provisions', Gross 934). Under the protocol that is the filing's figure, and the adopted +0.934 equals it. Conflicts in the filing: (1) the gross underwriting-year triangle gives -0.462m for UW 2016-2018. It excludes the 2019 underwriting year, whose provision at 1 January 2020 is part of the note's prior-year provisions, so the two measure different scopes. (2) The Managing Agent's report (p6) says 'A prior year release is included in this year’s ratio', but it gives no amount and speaks of the net loss ratio, while Note 11's net column shows +1,891. Neither is an explicit gross prior-year figure, so the note governs and the verdict is correct.

basis_check: The triangle row is headed 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred'. A separate net triangle follows on the same page (UW 2018 net 1,553 then 2,397). The gross table was used, as the record claims.

quote: p32 '3. Movement in prior year’s provision for claims outstanding': 'An overall improvement of £3.3 million on prior years’ provisions was experienced during the year.' Components: 'improvements of £3.6 million on property reinsurance and £0.2 million on marine reinsurance', 'a deterioration of £0.5 million on casualty reinsurance'. p18 Outward reinsurance premiums - | -; Reinsurers’ share (claims paid) - | -; Reinsurers’ share (change in provision) - | -. p36 Note 10 Claims outstanding, 2021 Gross | Reinsurers’ share | Net: At 1 January 106,650 | - | 106,650.
arithmetic: Note 3 states the movement directly: an improvement (release) of GBP 3.3m = -3.3m. Components -3.6 - 0.2 + 0.5 = -3.3. Tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 3.3 = 0.165) = 0.5; |-3.3 - (-3.3)| = 0.0, within.
basis_check: Note 3 does not say gross or net, but the syndicate buys no reinsurance of its own, so its gross and net figures are identical. p18: outward reinsurance premiums '-', reinsurers' share of claims paid '-' and of the change in provision '-'. p36 Note 10: reinsurers' share '-' on every line. p24: 'The syndicate has not purchased any additional reinsurance on its own account.' p44 prints one 'Gross and net' table. Inward business is ceded from host Syndicate 2121 net of the host's reinsurance (p24), but these are the syndicate's own gross figures. The filing does not make plain any net-for-gross substitution.
page_binding_check: Single-syndicate report headed 'Argenta Syndicate 6134'; Note 3 is 6134's own note. p5 says 6134 does not participate in any prior year of its host Syndicate 2121 and takes none of 2121's reinsurance to close. This syndicate's figure.
triangle_arithmetic: Reference only: the route is a model reading of Note 3, and the notes record CODE PYD NOT APPLIED, not an override. p44 'Gross and net insurance contract outstanding claims provision as at 31 December 2021', GBP000, translated at 31 December 2021 rates. UW years <= 2021 - 2 = 2019: 2018: 36 months later 25,190 - 24 months later 25,291 = -101; 2019: 24 months later 41,013 - 12 months later 38,387 = +2,626; sum +2,525 = +2.525m. The 'Current estimate' row 25,190 | 41,013 | 100,104 | 22,322 confirms the column alignment. Less payments 2,732 | 60 | 49 | 24 gives 22,458 | 40,953 | 100,055 | 22,298, total 185,764 = Note 10 closing. The stored grid matches the printed table.
reasoning: The filing states the prior-year movement explicitly in Note 3: an overall improvement of GBP 3.3m. With no outward reinsurance this is the gross figure, and the adopted -3.3 equals it. Conflicts in the filing: the underwriting-year triangle gives +2.525m for UW 2018-2019, the opposite sign. Note 10's 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' of 59,858 includes the 2020 underwriting year's newly earned exposure, so it is not development. Note 3 covers all provisions held at 1 January 2021 (including the earned part of UW 2020) on the annual basis; the triangle recomputation covers UW 2018-2019 only, at constant 2021 exchange rates. The two measure different scopes. The filing presents only Note 3 as the prior-year movement, so under the protocol it is the filing's figure. The p7 year-of-account commentary gives forecasts, not a prior-year movement figure. Verdict: correct.

quote: p29 Note 7 Technical Provisions – Claims Outstanding, 2020 Gross | Reinsurers’ Share | Net ($’000): Claims outstanding at 1 January 250,154 | 102,935 | 147,219; Change in estimates of technical provision provisions, including foreign exchange (17,705) | (5,533) | (12,172); Paid claims (51,808) | (32,451) | (19,357); Claims outstanding at 31 December 180,641 | 64,951 | 115,690. p17: 'the Syndicate ceased to write new business 1 January 2019'. p23 below the gross triangle: Liability recognised in the balance sheet 161,486; Reserve in respect of prior years 19,155; Total reserve included in balance sheet 180,641. p13: Gross claims paid (51,808); Change in the gross provision for claims 70,140.
arithmetic: Note 7 gross: 250,154 - 17,705 - 51,808 = 180,641, which ties to the closing balance, so the 2020 gross change in estimates is -17,705 USD000 = -17.705m. The filing includes FX in this figure; the P&L (p13) separates it. Gross claims incurred = -51,808 + 70,140 = 18,332 credit (segmental total 18,333, p27), and 70,140 - (250,154 - 180,641 = 69,513) = 627 FX, so ex-FX the movement is -18.333m. Tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 12.336 = 0.617) = 0.617. |-12.336 - (-17.705)| = 5.369 > 0.617; ex-FX |-12.336 - (-18.333)| = 5.997 > 0.617. Same sign; a magnitude error on either reading.
basis_check: Note 7's (17,705) is the Gross column (reinsurers' share (5,533), net (12,172)), and the triangle is headed 'Claims Outstanding (gross earned)'. Both gross. The Managing Director's report 'favourable net claims incurred development of $12 million' (p5) is the net counterpart (P&L net claims incurred credit 11,985). No basis issue.
page_binding_check: Single-syndicate report headed 'Syndicate 780' on every page; Note 7 and the triangle are 780's own. Syndicate 3500 appears only as the recipient of the reinsurance to close effective 1 January 2021, after the balance sheet date. This syndicate's figure.
triangle_arithmetic: p23 'Claims Outstanding (gross earned)', USD000, UW 2011-2018; report year 2020, so all eight UW years are <= 2018. 2011: 240,217 - 240,257 = -40; 2012: 117,407 - 119,584 = -2,177; 2013: 94,754 - 97,664 = -2,910; 2014: 123,021 - 123,663 = -642; 2015: 165,940 - 169,029 = -3,089; 2016: 190,267 - 191,075 = -808; 2017: 234,114 - 236,618 = -2,504; 2018: 168,289 - 168,455 = -166; sum -12,336 = -12.336m. Checks: every printed row total ties (e.g. At end of reporting year 932,529; Two years later 1,425,535; Three years later 1,209,338). Latest diagonal less cumulative payments reproduces the printed liabilities (240,217 - 227,529 = 12,688 ... 168,289 - 125,359 = 42,930; total 161,486). The stored grid matches the printed table. The grid has no column for underwriting years before 2011; their reserve (19,155) is added below it.
reasoning: Syndicate 780 wrote no new business from 1 January 2019 (p17), so there is no 2019 or 2020 underwriting year, and the whole 2020 change in the gross estimate relates to earlier years. Note 7 states that change explicitly in its gross column: -17.705m including FX, or -18.333m excluding FX from the P&L. The Managing Director's report likewise calls the year's whole net claims incurred credit 'favourable net claims incurred development'. The adopted -12.336m is the triangle recomputation, which covers only UW 2011-2018. The same page shows a further 19,155 'Reserve in respect of prior years' outside the grid. The net triangle has a similar gap: UW 2011-2018 net -6.015m against Note 7 net -12.172m. The filing does not itemise the roughly 5.4-6.0m difference, but it lies outside the triangle rows and inside the filing's own gross movement. The adopted figure differs from the filing's figure by 5.369m (5.997m ex-FX) against a 0.617m tolerance: error, magnitude. The canonical model's Note 7 reading (-17.705) agreed with the filing; the RAG triangle override replaced it with the partial-scope figure.
